messages:
Omar (Support): :rotating_light: P1 - Kestrel Health onboarding blocked by legal/PO delay. Billing can't provision the extra seats; customer trial users are hitting 403s when calling embeddings. Renewal signal strong if we fail to unblock by Monday.
Omar (Support): Error snippet from logs:
```text
403 Forbidden - organization quota exceeded
org_id: org-kestrel-004
requested_seats: 18
current_quota: 10
```

Maya (CS): @Priya can you join? I'll take lead on comms. We need a short comms plan + temporary unblock options. :eyes:

Priya (AM): On it. Pinged billing via ticket #BILL-9123, they said 1 business day for legal approval. I can offer a temporary 8-seat add-on to unblock while legal finishes signoff. Suggest sending a short customer note offering the temporary seats + requested ETA.

Maya (CS): Proposed quick comms note (feel free to copy):
```
Hi Alex,
We want to keep your team productive while legal completes the PO. We can provision a temporary 8-seat add-on today so your trial users can continue testing. This is temporary and will be reconciled once the PO is finalized. Please confirm if we should proceed.
— Maya, Customer Success
```

Omar (Support): Added reproduction + ticket link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-4589. Also attaching a short HAR and stacktrace in the ticket. Customer reports 6 users blocked in last 2 hours.

Ben (SRE): FYI we can also raise tenant quota to 25 temporarily via console if signoff will be >24h. Quick command for internal ops:
```
/console set-quota org-kestrel-004 25 --reason "temp unblock - legal pending"
```
This avoids repeated provisioning churn.

Maya (CS): Plan summary: 1) Offer temp 8-seat add-on via Priya today. 2) If customer agrees or legal expected >24h, Ben to elevate quota to 25 as a fallback. 3) Schedule 30m sync between Kestrel ENG + Priya + Maya to surface timeline and retention risks. 4) Flag renewal risk in Gainsight and set a follow-up for 2 weeks after signoff. I'll own the comms thread and update here. :white_check_mark:

Priya (AM): I'll send the note in 30m and copy @Maya. If no reply by EOD, I'll escalate to the CTO contact. Also looping billing-bot so finance sees the temporary credit.

billing-bot: Noted. Temporary seat add-ons require AM approval; charge will be prorated. Triggered ticket #BILL-9123 for manual adjust.

Omar (Support): Thanks team. Dropping the incident trace into the ticket and will mark support handoff complete once temp seats are provisioned. Please post final comms here so I can close the support loop. :handshake:
